column1: Any kind of file-like-structure. Reader will only return file paths. Not for use in production. Can be used as a placeholder for custom data management.
column2: Arrays are a series of data objects, without index.
column3: Array with additional index information for each element, that is not a datetime.
column4: An iarray that additionally has a name property of any valid metacatalog Variable.
column5: Array indexed by datetime information. The datetimes need to be of increasing order.
column6: Timeseries that holds an additional Variable name to describe the content.
column7: NDArrays are multidimensional arrays of common atomic data-type.
column9: The named raster images are not implemented yet.
column10: Special case of NDArray with exactly two dimensions.
column11: NDArray with any index except datetime information.
column12: idataframe with additional name property of any valid metacatalog Variable.
column13: NDArray indexed by datetime information. The datetimes need to be of increasing order.
column14: Timeseries table that holds an additional Variable name to describe the content.
